questions.question: India's Standard Meridian is 82°30' E longitude. If it is 1:00 PM Indian Standard Time (IST), what would be the local time at Greenwich (0° longitude)?

options.explanation: India's Standard Meridian is 82°30' E. Time difference from Greenwich (0° longitude) = 82.5° x 4 minutes/degree = 330 minutes. 330 minutes = 5 hours and 30 minutes. Since India is located East of Greenwich, Indian Standard Time (IST) is 5 hours and 30 minutes AHEAD of Greenwich Mean Time (GMT). To find the time at Greenwich, we subtract this difference from IST: 1:00 PM IST - 5 hours 30 minutes = 7:30 AM GMT.
This is not the correct time difference between IST and GMT.
This is not the correct time difference between IST and GMT, and it is also on the previous day.
This is not the correct time difference between IST and GMT.
